name: delegate_to_agent
description: Cold sub-agent; ASYNCHRONOUS task_id. It cannot see this conversation: task must include all context. Fan out, then Join. For each distinct agent/profile mention, call once; pass profile_id for a profile. admission_failed/admission_unknown: explicit replacement.

replacement_reason.description: With replaces_task_id. admission_failed/admission_unknown: explicit replacement, never continue. Established work follows central recovery; cancellation/stall never implies unresumable.

name: continue_delegation
description: Continue terminal task_id asynchronously with full context; never creates a child. Join via get_delegation_status.

name: get_delegation_status
description: task_ids in input order. Omit wait_ms for an immediate snapshot. Join: return_when=all_terminal_or_attention and wait_ms=0; positive wait_ms is rejected. Returns when all requested tasks are terminal, attention, or unavailable. Answer attention; re-Join only still-running required task_ids. Includes wake_reason and attention_requests.

name: cancel_delegation
description: Cancel only when its result is no longer wanted. timeout is non-canceling: keep waiting with get_delegation_status wait_ms for slow work. Already finished returns final result. taskfail, usercancel, and others cancel.

name: check_user_feedback
description: Messages are available only through this tool. Non-blocking; call before starting implementation, a significant decision, and after a meaningful sub-task. HIGH-PRIORITY; empty result means continue.

name: ask_user_question
description: Render interactive cards for 1-4 related multiple-choice questions and BLOCK until submitted or dismissed. Use only for a genuinely user-owned discrete decision that cannot be resolved from the request, code, or sensible defaults. Do not ask merely whether to proceed, confirm an obvious default, or collect open-ended input. Other is added automatically. Put a recommended choice first and append ' (Recommended)' to its label. Prefer one call for related questions.

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple options may be selected.

label.description: Short choice text; append ' (Recommended)' to the first recommended choice.

description.description: Meaning or trade-off of this choice.

name: get_session_info
description: Resolve codeg://session/ to read-only metadata and optional recent messages. Use internal conversation ID, not the agent session ID. Missing is found: false, not an error.

name: request_parent_decision
description: Ask the direct parent for a blocking decision. Blocks until reply or closure; not for progress, logs, or warnings.

name: reply_to_delegation
description: Reply to an open direct-child Join decision. First reply wins; same reply is idempotent.

name: request_recovery_authorization
description: After typed recovery_confirmation_required, request confirmation; replay the exact rejected call with recovery_authorization_id. Server derives action, target, warning, work-unit key, and delegation target. Structured results include subject_kind, subject_id, allowed_action, cause_code, expires_at, and action-specific target_state or replacement_reason metadata.

name: get_workflow_state
description: Load compact workflow index. Read plan/design/report_file for prose; use get_session_info/get_delegation_status for child/run detail.

name: recover_workflow
description: Root only. Call get_workflow_state, then request_recovery_authorization; use its receipt. Never creates a challenge.

name: publish_workflow_manifest
description: Publish/CAS v2 workflow manifest; Rust validates nested fields.

name: settle_workflow_gate
description: Root-only Design/Plan gate settle with structured evidence.

evidence.description: kind=design: critical_count, important_count, minor_count. kind=plan: scope full/scoped; revision_kind initial/localized/material/holistic_rewrite; scope_reason; covered_author_task_id; covered_plan_digest; required_reviewer_node_ids; finding_updates of finding_id, severity, status, owner_reviewer_node_ids, summary, evidence_ref, report_file; optional lineage_reset_reason.
